prerequisites: Knowledge of technological courses of the 1st year of study.

learning_outcomes.text: Familiarize students with the fundamentals of engineering technology.
Enable students to test practically individually selected operations.
Try practice some operations of single technologies on the base of which they would continue theoretical knowledge during their next bachelor of general type of study.
Acquainted with presented technologies and acquire manual skills when doing single operations, which they use during their further studies when preparing experiments.

syllabus_topics: Technology of presswork of sheet metal with practical application of operations of shearing, punching and bending on given components.
Technology of bulk forming with a view to free forging of material under heat using the operations of hot drawing, flattening and bending on given components.
Technology of gas welding, inclusive of mastering the fundamentals and manipulation with welding torch.
Technology of casting oriented to the fabrication of elementary mould and complicated mould with complicated parting plane.
Crystallization and solidification of castings.
Riseringst, stress, running system.
The production of casting moulds and models, the ways of moulding.
Machine moulding, permanent moulds, melting of metals.
The laws of plastic deformation in the forming process.
The production of metallurgical raw product – sheet metals, tubes, profiles, wires etc.
Sheet metal forming – technology of cutting, deep drawing, bending.
Bulk forming – extrusion, upsetting, forging.
Welding – fusion welding, the basic methods of flame and electricity welding.
Resistance welding, spot welding, seam welding, special ways.
Pressure welding, brazing.
The parting of metals-the methods’principles.
Review of introduce technologies, questions to the exame.
Stamping shop, forging shop, welding, foundry – manufacturing of products according to the technological process.
Basic information about metal sheet processing technology by cutting and bending.
Familiarization with the hand tools and machines that will be used in the work.
Basic information about hot metal forming technology by forging.
Familiarization with forging tools, machines for free forging and operation of forge.
Demonstration preparation and demonstration of burner ignition, types of flame, demonstration of welding sheet metal parts.
Description of a given task, individual training of material melting and fusion weld with filler material.
Introduction to melting equipment used in foundries.
Mold casting and casting evaluation.
Introduction and work safety.
Evaluation of exercises and credits.
assessment_rules: Course-unit credits are awarded based on attendance at seminars, correct elaboration, and active student participation. The final exam consists of written and oral parts and is classified according to the ECTS grading scale. Attendance in exercises is compulsory, and missed lessons can be compensated in other groups' lessons by agreement with the teacher.
institution: WYSOKÉ UCENI TECHNICKÉ V BRNE - Brno University of Technology
